## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing and SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND with SPY/TLT (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +4.45%) ↑ rising—but credit and cycle signals mixed, so money is rotating, not fleeing.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear falling: VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Reflation commodity push: CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Credit mixed but stable: HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16%) RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easing. UUP (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling while TLT (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND shows bond weakness; stocks vs bonds (SPY/TLT) ABOVE TREND confirms preference for risk assets.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Materials leading: XLB (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND. Tech holding: XLK (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) ABOVE TREND — style: Growth/momentum showing strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND. EM participation: EEM (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -0.62%) RECOVERY—China showing selective bounce while Japan and India lag.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative ETFs active but cooling: IWM (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +2.91%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +3.10%) ABOVE TREND suggest risk appetite, even as the Speculation Index (1W: -2.14% | 1M: -0.29%) BELOW TREND is drifting lower.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Metals and reflation trades dominating: SLV (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%) ABOVE TREND, GLD (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +9.65%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND — broad commodity bid.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed but positive: XLE (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.51%) RECOVERY, UNG (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -7.38%) RECOVERY — watch upside if demand signals persist.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) ABOVE TREND are both timeframes positive. DIVERGENCE: Bonds (TLT (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND) vs equities is the clearest cross-asset split; divergence severity: MINOR but monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and reflation: XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND, and commodity exposure (GLD (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +9.65%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength; reduce exposure to defensive utilities XLU (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Materials XLB (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND; Financials XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities XLU (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Staples XLP (1W: -0.23% | 1M: +0.93%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%) ABOVE TREND and Copper/CPER (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Broad oil recovery uneven — BNO (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.51%) RECOVERY remains vulnerable to demand prints.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND) = complacency marker. Credit spread ~0.73 (Credit Spread Level: 0.7285 | 1W: -0.16% | 1M: +1.01%) = watch for stress change. SPY/TLT 7.87 (SPY/TLT (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +4.45%) ↑ rising) = regime tilt.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive with VXX (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ABOVE TREND confirming flows into riskier assets while money shifts across sectors. Materials XLB (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND, Financials XLF (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +9.65%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength; key risk is bond-equity divergence (TLT (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND) that could re-introduce volatility.
